department: Department of Biostatistics, School of Public Health

deadline.value: The catalog gives priority to applications received before December 1, 2026; it gives no later final date.
deadline.quote: Applications received prior to Dec 1 given priority consideration

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional; applicants may submit the verbal, quantitative and analytical writing scores.
gre_general.quote: Applicants have the option to complete the verbal, quantitative and analytical writing sections of the Graduate Record Examination

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog does not say how many students are funded.

entry_route.value: The catalog lists required math courses but does not say whether a master's is needed.
entry_route.quote: the following mathematics courses or their equivalents are required for admission: MATH 307, MATH 310, STAT 309 and STAT 212

notes: Catalog only: the program page at biostatistics.vcu.edu and the School of Public Health admissions page returned HTTP 502. The School of Public Health catalog gives the program rules above; the Graduate School English rule on the university record applies.
